correctness.rationale: Independently classified all 343 ordered support triples, then composed the color maps around each support cycle. Each lap permutes the occupied colors in every shore, so true labelled-state entry is exactly support entry, with least period given by the support period times the lap-permutation order. For instance, the triple of full supports is fixed as a support triple but its full state has period three. After applying inclusion–exclusion for the number of assignments with each exact support, all 270 coefficients (ten classes, 27 exponential bases) match, with every omitted class zero. Replay: python3 /workspace/audit_evidence/excitation.py. The singleton triangle has six depth-three states and none at depth four. The positive term Y−X−3 supplies depth-four examples for every other size triple. Periods 1 and 3 and entry by time four imply F^7=F^4. For a=b=c=n, each of N_(1,3), N_(2,3), N_(3,3) has leading term 3·12^n while all other transient terms grow strictly more slowly; normalizing by 27^n gives the probability and conditional limits. The arguments apply to labelled, positive-shore, synchronous threshold-one three-state GHM only.
